propositions: init.py at 786 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC hard cap with only 14 lines of headroom and must be split along a call-graph boundary
init.py contains two independent subsystems with no calls between them: tracker provisioning (init command) and tickets-branch convergence units whose sole caller is _store/ensures._registry()
Convergence units and their content templates (_GITIGNORE, _GITATTRIBUTES) should move to a new _init_ensures.py module since they are only called by lazy-import dispatch, not by init.py itself

_untrack_runtime_markers_unit and _UNTRACK_BATCH must remain in init.py because test_ensures_untrack_markers.py patches _UNTRACK_BATCH as an init module attribute, and moving it would silently break that test's multi-batch assertion
Re-exports from init.py preserve all external module-attribute references and registry wiring so that _store/ensures._registry() and test imports continue to resolve without modification

All path-keyed registries (.github/complexity-baseline.json, scripts/check_raw_git_writes.py, test_cli_seam_clean_heldout.py) remain valid after the move because no symbol keys change and marker budgets are unchanged
